name: GlogauAIR Open Studios March 2026
description: GlogauAIR's Open Studios invites the public to witness three months of intensive research and production by international resident artists, both on-site in Berlin and online. The exhibition includes painting, video, sculpture, and performance. In the Project Space, a collaboration between curator Virginia Valeri and photographer Giulia Gr presents 'Melancholia Archive,' exploring fragility, memory, and transformation across 10 years of material.
